sloka: इममर्थं हि विज्ञाप्य रामं सुग्रीवमेव च।तौ यत् प्रतिविधास्येते तत् करिष्यामहे वयम् ।। ६.८२.२३ ।।
transliteration: imamarthaṁ hi vijñāpya rāmaṁ sugrīvameva ca।tau yat pratividhāsyete tat kariṣyāmahe vayam ।। 6.82.23 ।।

translations.english: The foremost of the Vanaras, kept back all the Vanaras after speaking that way to the army and slowly and slowly retreated.
